subject.title: [Feature]: First-class org/team deployment — workspace scaffolding, RBAC, and deployment manifests

question: Which parts of the org/team deployment umbrella should OpenClaw core own now, and what first supported security/config contract should be designed?
rationale: The requested CLI scaffold, deployment manifest, and RBAC model would define new product and security contracts across config, Gateway auth, sessions, tool policy, and docs, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent boundary.

options.title: Decompose under this umbrella
options.body: Keep #43673 open and approve narrow sub-issues only after threat-model, config, and upgrade contracts are explicit.

options.title: Route non-core setup outward
options.body: Keep core focused on missing auth/session/tool-policy APIs while scaffolding and deployment manifests live in plugins, docs, or external tooling.

options.title: Decline first-class team mode for now
options.body: Close the umbrella after documenting separate gateways, trusted proxy, and per-agent profiles as the supported isolation pattern.

recommendation.title: Decompose under this umbrella
recommendation.body: Keep #43673 open and approve narrow sub-issues only after threat-model, config, and upgrade contracts are explicit.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history across conversation capability profiles and gateway trust-model documentation adjacent to the requested boundary.
